components.name: Sign-in form
components.behavior: Validates that both credential fields are filled, disables the button while a simulated 600ms request runs, accepts exactly admin/admin to enter the app, and shows a generic inline error for anything else without revealing whether the account exists.
components.state: authed flag, required-field validation state, pending-submission lock
components.maps_to: FUNC-001 Sign in with email and password

components.name: Sign out action
components.behavior: Header 'Salir' button on the incident list resets the authenticated state and returns to the sign-in screen with a confirmation toast.
components.state: clears authed flag and resets active filter

components.name: Status filter chips
components.behavior: Tapping Todas/Pendiente/En progreso/Resuelta filters the in-page incident array by status and updates each chip's live count badge.
components.state: selected filter key; recomputed per-status counts from the incidents array

components.name: Incident list
components.behavior: Renders only the owned incidents newest-first (title, category, priority, status badge, creation date) and shows an empty state when the active filter matches nothing.
components.state: incidents array filtered by current filter, sorted by creation date descending

components.name: New incident form
components.behavior: Live per-field validation (title 5-100 chars, description 10-1000 chars with char counters, required category and priority choice groups), disables the submit button while saving, then prepends a new Pendiente incident with an initial history entry and returns to the list with a confirmation toast.
components.state: form field values, touched flags, selected category/priority, duplicate-submission lock
components.maps_to: FUNC-005 Create a new incident (with INSTR-002 initial Pending status)

components.name: Incident detail with status history
components.behavior: Tapping a list card opens the detail view showing identifier, title, description, category, priority, status badge, creation date, and a newest-first chronological status-history timeline; a missing id renders a safe no-access state.
components.state: selected incident id used to look up the in-page incident and its history entries
components.maps_to: FUNC-006 View incident details and status history

components.name: Screen navigation
components.behavior: Bottom navigation bar plus drill-down (list to detail, FAB and back buttons) switches between the four screens via JS view switching, scrolling each view back to top.
